identities.label: Platform & SRE View
identities.title: Senior Platform & SRE Engineer
identities.summary: Senior Software Developer specializing in Platform Engineering with 3 years of end-to-end infrastructure ownership at ZeOmega (HIPAA-compliant healthcare SaaS). Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA, 2026) with expertise in production-grade HA systems (Redis Sentinel 3+3, Memcached HA), mTLS PKI security, HashiCorp Vault HA, 20+ component Prometheus/Grafana observability stack, and Jenkins CI/CD pipelines cutting deployment cycles from 3 weeks to under 24 hours.

description: Architected Redis Sentinel HA (3+3 topology) and Memcached HA from scratch across a microservices platform, eliminating all single points of failure; validated with Memtier Benchmark & Locust across throughput, latency, failover time, and memory limits; tuned maxmemory and eviction policies; documented failover behaviour and Memcached internals.

Built one-click Jenkins CI/CD pipelines for Redis and Memcached deployments (HA + TLS + version management + integrated testing) — cutting each rollout cycle from 3 weeks to under 24 hours; automated x.509 certificate generation and rotation across all pipeline stages.

Introduced mTLS security architecture from scratch across inter-service communication using x.509 certificates; architected a highly available HashiCorp Vault cluster with AppRole authentication and automated certificate rotation; enforced Redis multitenancy via ACL-based data isolation and delivered audit logging for HIPAA compliance.

Independently built end-to-end observability platform using Prometheus + Grafana covering 20+ infrastructure components (RabbitMQ, Redis HA, Memcached, MongoDB, RHEL & Windows VMs); configured mongodb_exporter telemetry; reported and validated metric gatherer registration conflicts under MongoDB 8.3.x (percona/mongodb_exporter issue #1285).

Deployed and managed stateful workloads on a 3-node bare-metal Kubernetes cluster with Longhorn persistent storage; resolved production DNS caching incidents; stress-tested workloads for fault tolerance and data durability before rollout.

Eliminated production message-drop incidents by redesigning RabbitMQ batch consumer with optimised processing workflows — 200% throughput improvement, zero data loss across critical healthcare data pipelines; directly reduced client-facing downtime.

Benchmarked Milvus vs pgvector across 1M vectors (1024-dim) for latency, recall & throughput; findings directly influenced team's vector search architecture; contributed bug fix merged into VectorDB-Bench open source codebase.

projects.name: Smart Queue Processor
projects.description: Fault-tolerant messaging infrastructure with pluggable Redis/RabbitMQ adapter architecture.
projects.longDescription: Backend-agnostic event-driven queue system with pluggable adapter architecture (Redis/RabbitMQ). Implemented batching, configurable retry logic, and Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) for guaranteed message delivery and zero data loss under failure conditions; Dockerised for consistent multi-environment deployment; FastAPI load producer enables throughput benchmarking and stress testing.
